## Session Context (Nekomimi)

You have access to a substrate-independent embodiment layer with 17 intent tokens (nod, shake, sulk, etc.) and 4 body renderers (Boomy robot, VRM, Reachy Mini, BHL). The LLM emits ONLY intent tokens — never joint angles. Use intent_tool(token="...") to express emotion.

**Before starting:** 1. list_intents() to see available tokens. 2. list_renderers() to see connected bodies. 3. Use intent_tool(token="attending") to test.

**At end of work:** Save intent streams via recordings_list() for regression tests.
